item.title: Introduction
item.description: Launched with Iron Man in 2008, the MCU has transformed the film industry and earned over $21 billion, examined here through data analysis.

item.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
item.description: Marvel fans actively engaged with new characters and productions, demonstrating the success of Marvel’s transition for the past two decades.

item.title: Machine Learning
item.description: Reddit sentiment analysis suggests positive fan reception to MCU content from Jan 2021–Apr 2022, aligning with Disney’s strong stock performance and successful business strategy.

item.title: Natural Language Processing
item.description: Reddit activity reveals trending content and audience interests, showing strong streaming growth potential even amid fluctuations in sentiment throughout the day.

item.title: Conclusion
item.description: NLP analysis of Reddit reveals Wanda Maximoff’s unexpected popularity, highlights the value of diversity in the MCU, and shows potential links between fan engagement and Disney’s stock performance.
